Hrothgar's Landing is a small island located off the northern coast of Icecrown, in Northrend. The Sea Reaver's Run is the strait between Hrothgar's Landing and the continent.
The adventurers who have risen in the ranks of the Argent Tournament, and were awarded with the title of <Crusader> by the Argent Crusade, were directed to the island with a new series of quests surrounding the kvaldir's taking of the island from the tuskarr.

The [[Sea Reaver's Run]] is the strait between Hrothgar's Landing and the continent. The [[adventurer]]s who have risen in the ranks of the [[Argent Tournament]], and were awarded with the title of {{title|[[Crusader (title)|Crusader]]}} by the [[Argent Crusade]], were directed to the island with a new series of quests surrounding the [[kvaldir]]'s taking of the island from the [[tuskarr]]. ==History== There was once a [[tuskarr]] [[Hrothgar's Landing#Speculation|village]] here, until it was conquered by [[Drottinn Hrothgar]] and his [[kvaldir]] who renamed it "Hrothgar's Landing",[[Stop The Aggressors]] while its inhabitants have all been slain or driven away by the kvaldir.''[[Exploring Azeroth: Northrend]]'', pg. 131 During the [[war against the Lich King]] in 27 ADP, the island became a mist-shrouded staging point from which the kvaldir, or "sea vrykul" as they are often known as, staged attacks against the [[Silver Covenant]] and the [[Sunreavers]]' ships on the Sea Reaver's Run.[http://www.worldofwarcraft.com/info/underdev/argent-tournament.html WoW -> Under Development -> Argent Tournament] Their ships fought the kvaldir back from Icecrown's main shore and had to slay the [[kraken]] they kept summoning, with the help of [[adventurer]]s.[[Get Kraken!]] After the [[war against the Jailer]] in 36 ADP, the [[Bronzebeard]] brothers reported that the island is still under the control of the kvaldir, and their [[Kvaldir Deepcaller|deepcallers]] are still bringing up krakens to attack any ship that tries to pass through the strait. ==Geography== ===Maps and subregions=== [[File:WorldMap-HrothgarsLanding.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Map of Hrothgar's Landing.]] {| class="darktable hlist" |- | *[[Mistcaller's Cave]] *[[North Sea|The North Sea]] *[[The Sea Reaver's Run]] **''[[Bor's Fury]]'' **''[[The Firehawk]]'' **''[[The Wavecrest]]'' |- || ---- ;[[Undisplayed location]]s *''[[The Crimson Dawn]]'' *''[[The Silver Blade]]'' |} {{clear|left}} ===Adjacent regions=== {| class="darktable zebra" |- ! Access |- | [[The Storm Peaks]] || {{Horde}}{{Alliance}} || 67 - 80 | Southeast || By flying mount |- | [[Icecrown]] || {{Horde}}{{Alliance}} || 67 - 80 | South || By flying mount |} ==Notable characters== {{main|Hrothgar's Landing NPCs}} ==Trivia== *Hrothgar's Landing is the second outdoor zone added to the game in a content patch since [[Isle of Quel'Danas (Burning Crusade)|Isle of Quel'Danas]] was added in [[Patch 2.4.0|2.4.0]]. *It is the northernmost point that players may freely access on Azeroth; but the [[Lost Glacier]], only visited once by [[death knight]] players, lies even further north. ==Speculation== {{speculation}} Since the slain tuskarr on the island are called [[Slain Tualiq Villager]], "Tualiq" is most likely the former name of the island, the village, or both. ==Gallery== File:Mistcaller's Cave.jpg|[[Mistcaller's Cave]] File:The Sea Reaver's Run.jpg|[[Sea Reaver's Run]] File:Bor's Fury.jpg|''[[Bor's Fury]]'' ==Patch changes== *{{Patch 7.3.5|note=Level scaling implemented, previous zone level: 77 - 80.}} *{{Hotfix|date=2016-07-21|bluenote=The NPCs who went missing from Hrothgar's Landing have been returned.|link=http://us.battle.net/wow/en/blog/20189510/}} *{{Patch 3.2.0|note=Added.}} ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== {|class=darktable |{{Elinks-zone|4742}} |{{Elinks-zone|4769}} |} {{Hrothgar's Landing}} {{Northrend}} [[Category:Hrothgar's Landing| ]] [[Category:Kvaldir territories]] [[Category:Tuskarr territories]] [[Category:Islands]] [[Category:North Sea]]
